title: Influence of Self-Efficacy and Metacognition on Malaysian Pre-University Students’ Chemistry Academic Motivation: The Moderating Role of Gender and Locality
content:
Chem. Educ. Res. Pract., 2025, Accepted Manuscript

This study explores the relationships among self-efficacy, metacognition, and academic motivation in chemistry, focusing on the moderating roles of gender and locality among Malaysian pre-university students. Using a quantitative approach,...
